definitions.explanation: The act of traveling to a destination, especially for pleasure or exploration. Often has a poetic or literary nuance compared to 旅行.

examples.english: To set out on a long journey.

examples.japanese: {旅|たび}の{途中|とちゅう}で{素敵|すてき}な{場所|ばしょ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a wonderful place during my travels.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}は{旅|たび}のようなものだ。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅|たび}に{出|で}る (to set out on a journey)
- {旅|たび}をする (to travel)
- {旅|たび}の{思|おも}い{出|で} (travel memories)
- {旅|たび}の{疲|つか}れ (travel fatigue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅|たび}: Journey (poetic, literary, emphasizes the experience)
- {旅行|りょこう}: Trip, travel (general, practical term)
- {旅路|たびじ}: Journey, travels (literary)

PROVERB:
- {旅|たび}の{恥|はじ}は{掻|か}き{捨|す}て: What happens on the road stays on the road (One can be less inhibited when traveling)
